brief:
Hossam Badran, head of the national relations office in Hamas, placed a telephone call to Father Manuel Muslim to inquire about his condition following a recent health episode, Shehab Wire reported. Badran expressed wishes for the priest's full recovery and continued wellness during the conversation.

The call served as an opportunity for Badran to update Father Muslim on the latest political developments unfolding in the region. The outreach underscores ongoing engagement between the Hamas movement and religious figures in Palestinian society.
